items.text: Show affection to your relatives, so that there is no grumbling or resentment among your uncles and brethren.
items.citation: The Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 21, Zhu Xi chapter 20 (part 2-3)
items.quote: By showing affection to his relatives, there is no grumbling nor resentment among his uncles and brethren.

items.text: Give your relatives places of honor and large emolument, and share with them in their likes and dislikes, to encourage them to love you.
items.citation: The Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 21, Zhu Xi chapter 20 (part 2-3)
items.quote: Giving them places of honor and large emolument. and sharing with them in their likes and dislikes

items.text: Obey your parents; for without obedience you will not be true to friends.
items.citation: The Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 21, Zhu Xi chapter 20 (part 2-3)
items.quote: if one is not obedient to his parents, he will not be true to friends.

heading: Zhong Yong 中庸 · The Doctrine of the Mean (Legge 1893) · Zhong Yong 19 · Zhu Xi chapter 19 … Zhu Xi chapter 20 (part 1)

items.text: Carry out the wishes of your forefathers and carry forward their undertakings.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 19
items.quote: skillful carrying out of the wishes of our forefathers, and the skillful carrying forward of their undertakings.

items.text: Repair their temple halls, present the offerings of the seasons, and serve the departed as you would serve them alive.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 19
items.quote: repaired and beautified the temple halls of their fathers, set forth their ancestral vessels, displayed their various robes, and presented the offerings of the several seasons.
items.conflict: Worship is due to God alone; serving the dead is necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12).

items.text: At family rites, let the inferiors present the cup to their superiors and give precedence according to age.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 19
items.quote: the inferiors presented the cup to their superiors, and thus something was given the lowest to do.

items.text: Serve your parents; do not neglect them.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: Wishing to cultivate his character, he may not neglect to serve his parents.

items.text: Love your relatives, for benevolence is shown in loving relatives.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: the great exercise of it is in loving relatives.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as a father to your son.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as a son to your father.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as a husband to your wife.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as a wife to your husband.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as an elder brother to your younger brother.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

items.text: Fulfill your duty as a younger brother to your elder brother.
items.citation: Doctrine of the Mean, Zhong Yong 20 (part 1)
items.quote: The duties are those between sovereign and minister, between father and son, between husband and wife, between elder brother and younger, and those belonging to the intercourse of friends.

heading: Zhong Yong 中庸 · The Doctrine of the Mean (Legge 1893) · Zhong Yong 13 · Zhu Xi chapter 13 … Zhu Xi chapter 18

items.text: Serve your father as you would have your own son serve you.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 13
items.quote: To serve my father, as I would require my son to serve me

items.text: Serve your elder brother as you would have your own younger brother serve you.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 13
items.quote: to serve my elder brother as I would require my younger brother to serve me

items.text: Maintain a happy union with your wife, like lutes and harps playing in harmony.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 15
items.quote: Happy union with wife and children is like the music of lutes and harps

items.text: Live in concord with your brothers, making harmony delightful and enduring.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 15
items.quote: When there is concord among brethren, the harmony is delightful and enduring

items.text: By maintaining harmony with your wife and children and concord among siblings, bring entire satisfaction to your parents.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 15
items.quote: In such a state of things, parents have entire complacence!

items.text: Fast, purify yourself, and dress in your richest clothes to attend the sacrifices to the spirits.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 16
items.quote: They cause all the people in the kingdom to fast and purify themselves, and array themselves in their richest dresses, in order to attend at their sacrifices.
items.conflict: Worship belongs to God alone; do not offer sacrifices to spirits (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: Offer sacrifices in the ancestral temple, and ensure your descendants preserve them for you.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 17
items.quote: He offered his sacrifices in his ancestral temple, and his descendants preserved the sacrifices to himself.
items.conflict: Do not offer sacrifices to the dead; honor ancestors by remembering them, not by worship (Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: In mourning for your father or mother, make no distinction between noble and mean; observe the full mourning.
items.citation: Zhong Yong, 18
items.quote: In the mourning for a father or mother, he allowed no difference between the noble and the mean.
